surface.background: fully opaque pale gray matte ground based on #EEF2F4
surface.alternate: slightly cooler pale gray ground based on #DDE5E9 for non-golden variants
surface.finish: quiet editorial architectural-model surface with no visible texture pattern

palette_roles.module: restrained medium blue based on #4B8FD8 defines active infrastructure modules
palette_roles.active_transition: a single amber path based on #E8A43A carries the one supported operational journey
palette_roles.edge: deep slate based on #243746 defines crisp module edges and deterministic plaques
palette_roles.inactive: muted blue-gray based on #AABAC5 supports subordinate modules without creating another focal route
palette_roles.ground: pale gray remains the dominant field and preserves spatial breathing room

line_language.primary: crisp three-pixel-equivalent isometric edges with consistent projection and corner treatment
line_language.paths: one clean continuous amber route with restrained bends and no decorative branching
line_language.boundaries: platform edges and ownership zones use quiet slate outlines without dashboard frames or blueprint construction lines

material_and_texture.surface: pale gray matte ground plane with extremely subtle ambient occlusion
material_and_texture.objects: substantial modules rendered as restrained matte architectural solids rather than servers gadgets or toys
material_and_texture.finish: low-texture non-glossy material with consistent face values and no glass metal chrome or plastic shine

geometry.projection: fixed 30-degree isometric camera shared by every plane module path and plaque
geometry.modules: three to five substantial modules with coherent platform thickness eight-pixel corner treatment and consistent scale family
geometry.grounding: simple platforms and measured spatial grouping replace card grids cities and decorative container piles
geometry.focal_rule: one visible source-to-destination journey dominates while every inactive module remains subordinate

depth_and_camera.mode: fixed 30-degree isometric projection with no random perspective or mixed camera angles
depth_and_camera.elevation: low controlled elevation may clarify confirmed ownership or sequence but never invent importance
depth_and_camera.lighting: one soft directional light and one shared shadow direction with no glow multiple suns or dramatic contrast

typography.voice: quiet sans-serif grounded captions on deterministic platform plaques
typography.exact_text: titles labels and module names are applied deterministically after semantics are confirmed
typography.generated_text: image generation keeps modules plaques and ground free of readable text logos and interface screens

density_and_spacing.density: medium-low spatial density with three to five substantial modules rather than miniature infrastructure clutter
density_and_spacing.spacing: fifty-six-pixel-equivalent module gaps and ninety-six-pixel outer margins preserve architectural-model calm
density_and_spacing.occupancy: the coherent world occupies roughly seventy-four to eighty-two percent while one title-safe or caption-safe area remains usable

required_traits: pale gray matte ground remains fully opaque and visually dominant
fixed 30-degree isometric camera module scale platform thickness and light direction remain consistent
three to five substantial modules create one coherent editorial architectural diorama
a single amber journey is continuous dominant and readable at thumbnail size
one shared shadow direction grounds every object without dramatic lighting
forbidden_traits: no miniature server racks dense cloud campus city clutter vendor logos branded products or interface screens
no glossy toy plastic transparent glass chrome photorealistic material neon glow or dark cinematic atmosphere
no random perspective mixed camera angles inconsistent module scale multiple light directions or floating ungrounded modules
no multiple amber routes decorative pipe networks unsupported modules connections ownership hierarchy or topology
no front-orthographic drafting grid cutaway construction-line aesthetic fake dimensions or Style 4 blueprint language
no dark luminous circuitry transparent neon panels or Style 3 science-fiction language

neighbor_boundaries.difference: Style 5 uses matte solids fixed isometric projection meaningful elevation and directional shadows; Style 4 is flat orthographic line-led almost volumeless drafting construction
Style 5 uses pale matte daylight restrained saturation and no glow; Style 3 uses dark atmospheric grounds neon emission transparent glass and luminous circuitry
